# Test fixtures

Small hand-written notes under `notes/`. The sample `notes/` folder at the repo root is never touched.

| File | Exercises |
|---|---|
| `notes/header_style_a.md` | Header style A (`# Meeting:`, `Date:`, `Attendees:`) |
| `notes/header_style_b.md` | Header style B (YAML front matter, bracketed attendees) |
| `notes/markers.md` | Checkbox markers `- [ ]`, `- [x]`, `- [X]`, `* [ ]`, `+ [ ]` |
| `notes/nested.md` | Nested checkbox pair (independent items) |
| `notes/code_block_decoy.md` | Checkbox inside a fenced code block (flagged) |
| `notes/comment_decoy.md` | Checkbox inside an HTML comment (flagged) |
| `notes/empty.md` | Empty file (skipped) |
| `notes/binary.md` | Binary file with `.md` extension (skipped) |
| `notes/no_date.md` | Missing date (skipped) |
| `notes/bad_date.md` | Invalid date (skipped) |
| `notes/not_a_note.txt` | Wrong extension (skipped) |
